  ss_base: ""
  assessment_base: ""
  data_dir: ""
  scenarios: !expr c(
    "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base",
    "Scenario_2/Scn02_base",
    "Scenario_3/Sc3_Base"
  )
  retro_scenarios: !expr c("Scenario_2/Scn02_base", "Scenario_3/Sc3_Base")
  reference_scenario: "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base"
  scenario_register: !expr data.frame(id = character(0), label = character(0), purpose = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  capabilities: !expr list()
  jobs: !expr list()
  paper_figures: !expr character(0)
  profile_import_from: null
  profile_scenario: "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base"
  cv_scenario: "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base"
  appendix_dir: ""
  project_dir: ""
  ss_version: ""
  pe_ss3_sma_dir: ""
  run_code: true
  launch_profiles: false
  strict_errors: true
---

<!--
Required R packages (robustness diagnostics):

  tier       package    role
  --------   ---------  --------------------------------------------------
  core       knitr      knit template; format LaTeX tables
  run_code   r4ss       read SS3 output across scenarios
  run_code   FLRebuild  curveSS(); scenario time series and process residuals
  run_code   ss3om      readFLSss3(); FLR stock objects from SS3
  run_code   sstruth    retrospective and hindcast data extraction
  run_code   ggplot2    scenario comparison and hindcast figures
  run_code   plyr       summarise scenario outputs
  run_code   reshape2   reshape scenario tables for plotting
  planned    dplyr      summarise scenario outputs
  planned    tidyr      reshape scenario / ensemble tables
  planned    FLCore     FLR stock objects for status and reference points
  planned    FLRebuild  rebuilding metrics and projections (extended)
  planned    kobe       Kobe-phase and status classification plots
  run_code   mvtnorm    MVLN sampling from SS3 covariance matrix
  run_code   patchwork  Optional multi-panel MVLN status figures

Source material: pe-ss3-sma/PE-sma-results.Rmd (curveSS, scenario ts, residuals),
                 pe-ss3-sma/PE-backtest.Rmd, config-defaults.R,
                 sstruth::retroBacktestData(), mvln/R/ssMVLNFunction.R
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(params$appendix_dir, "R", "appendix-utils.R"))
cfg <- resolve_appendix_params(params)
load_appendix_helpers(cfg)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.path = file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "figs", "robustness", "robustness-"),
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 200
)

dir.create(file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "figs", "robustness"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)
paths <- scenario_paths(cfg)
paths_ok <- paths[dir.exists(paths)]
do_run <- isTRUE(cfg$run_code) && length(paths_ok) > 0L
if (do_run) {
  require_ok(length(paths_ok) > 0L, "No SS3 scenario directories found under ss_base", cfg)
}
ss3 <- if (do_run) load_assessment_case_study(cfg) else NULL
st_rob <- if (do_run) load_assessment_robustness(cfg) else NULL
catch_bt <- if (do_run) load_collected_catch_backtests(cfg) else NULL
mvln <- if (do_run) load_mvln_ensemble(cfg) else NULL
cv_weights <- if (do_run) load_collected_ensemble_cv_weights(cfg) else NULL
weight_cmp <- if (do_run) ensemble_weight_comparison(cfg) else NULL
if (do_run) {
  require_data(catch_bt$summary, "Catch back-test summary", cfg)
  require_ok(!is.null(mvln$terminal), "MVLN terminal draws", cfg)
}
if (do_run && is.null(weight_cmp) && !is.null(cv_weights) && !is.null(cv_weights$weight_comparison)) {
  weight_cmp <- cv_weights$weight_comparison
}
```

```{r write-libraries, include=FALSE}
robustness_libraries <- data.frame(
  package = c(
    "knitr", "r4ss", "FLRebuild", "ss3om", "sstruth", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "plyr",
    "reshape2", "tidyr", "FLCore", "kobe", "mvtnorm", "patchwork"
  ),
  role = c(
    "Knit template; format LaTeX tables",
    "Read SS3 output across scenarios",
    "curveSS(); scenario time series and process residuals",
    "readTruth / readFLSss3(); FLR stock objects from SS3",
    "retroBacktestData, plotRatios, ssPeDiagnose, plotSpSsb",
    "Scenario comparison, retrospective, and MVLN figures",
    "Retrospective trajectory plots (trajMsyLong); MVLN time-series summaries",
    "Summarise scenario outputs (ddply)",
    "Reshape scenario tables and MVLN draws (melt/cast)",
    "Reshape scenario and ensemble tables (planned)",
    "FLR stock objects for status and reference points (planned)",
    "Kobe-phase plots (planned; ggplot used for MVLN Kobe comparison)",
    "Multivariate normal sampling for MVLN status uncertainty",
    "Combine MVLN status time-series panels (optional)"
  ),
  tier = c(
    "core", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code",
    "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code",
    "planned", "planned", "planned", "run_code", "run_code"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write_libraries(cfg, "robustness", robustness_libraries)
```

```{r write-scenarios, include=FALSE}
if (!is.null(cfg$scenario_register) && is.data.frame(cfg$scenario_register) && NROW(cfg$scenario_register)) {
  reg <- cfg$scenario_register
  scenario_register <- data.frame(
    scenario = reg$id,
    class = if ("class" %in% names(reg)) reg$class else c("reference", rep("structural sensitivity", NROW(reg) - 1L)),
    purpose = if ("purpose" %in% names(reg)) reg$purpose else reg$label,
    include_in_ensemble = TRUE,
    weight = if (!is.null(mvln) && !is.null(mvln$weights)) {
      unname(mvln$weights[reg$id])
    } else {
      rep(1 / NROW(reg), NROW(reg))
    },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  scenario_register <- data.frame(
    scenario = cfg$scenarios,
    class = c("reference", rep("structural sensitivity", length(cfg$scenarios) - 1L)),
    purpose = c(
      "Working / accepted model configuration",
      "Alternative structural assumption 1",
      "Alternative structural assumption 2"
    )[seq_along(cfg$scenarios)],
    include_in_ensemble = c(TRUE, rep(TRUE, length(cfg$scenarios) - 1L)),
    weight = if (!is.null(mvln) && !is.null(mvln$weights)) {
      unname(mvln$weights[cfg$scenarios])
    } else {
      rep(1 / length(cfg$scenarios), length(cfg$scenarios))
    },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

write_content(
  cfg,
  "robustness/scenarios.tex",
  c(
    kable_fragment(
      scenario_register,
      caption = "Scenario register for robustness diagnostics.",
      label = "tab:robustness-scenarios"
    ),
    ""
  )
)
```

```{r write-checks, include=FALSE}
checks_lines <- c("% Robustness diagnostic checks.", "")

if (!is.null(ss3) && !is.null(ss3$pe)) {
  pe_summary <- summarise_pe_scenarios(ss3$pe)
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    kable_fragment(
      pe_summary,
      caption = "Terminal-year scenario status relative to MSY reference points (from curveSS).",
      label = "tab:robustness-pe-summary"
    ),
    ""
  )
}

if (!is.null(st_rob) && !is.null(st_rob$ss_pe)) {
  sspe_tbl <- ss_pe_diagnostics_table(st_rob$ss_pe)
  if (!is.null(sspe_tbl)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        sspe_tbl,
        caption = "Surplus-production misspecification flags by scenario (sstruth::ssPeDiagnose).",
        label = "tab:robustness-sspe"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(st_rob) && !is.null(st_rob$retro) && !is.null(st_rob$retro$oneStep)) {
  one_step <- st_rob$retro$oneStep
  num_cols <- vapply(one_step, is.numeric, logical(1))
  one_step[num_cols] <- lapply(one_step[num_cols], function(x) signif(x, 4))
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    kable_fragment(
      one_step,
      caption = "One-step-ahead retrospective errors (sstruth::retroBacktestData).",
      label = "tab:robustness-retro-onestep"
    ),
    ""
  )
}

if (!is.null(mvln) && !is.null(mvln$summary)) {
  mvln_tbl <- mvln_summary_table(mvln)
  if (!is.null(mvln_tbl)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        mvln_tbl,
        caption = paste0(
          "Terminal-year MVLN status uncertainty by scenario (year ",
          mvln$terminal_year,
          "). Harvest = F/FMSY from Hessian draws."
        ),
        label = "tab:robustness-mvln-terminal"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(catch_bt) && !is.null(catch_bt$summary) && NROW(catch_bt$summary)) {
  bt_tbl <- catch_bt$summary
  num_cols <- vapply(bt_tbl, is.numeric, logical(1))
  bt_tbl[num_cols] <- lapply(bt_tbl[num_cols], function(x) signif(x, 4))
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    kable_fragment(
      bt_tbl,
      caption = "Catch back-test forecast summaries by peel and forecast scenario (collected via run-catch-backtests.R).",
      label = "tab:robustness-catch-backtest"
    ),
    ""
  )
}

if (length(checks_lines) <= 2L) {
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    "% Retrospective, hindcast, and sensitivity summaries.",
    if (do_run && !retro_dirs_available(cfg)) {
      c(
        "% Retrospective directories not found; run pe-ss3-sma/run-retros.R then re-render.",
        ""
      )
    } else {
      c(
        "% Set run_code = TRUE to populate from curveSS() and sstruth::retroBacktestData().",
        ""
      )
    }
  )
}

write_content(cfg, "robustness/checks.tex", checks_lines)
```

```{r write-output, include=FALSE}
output_lines <- c("% Robustness diagnostic figures.", "")

if (!is.null(ss3) && !is.null(ss3$pe)) {
  save_curve_ss_paper_figures(cfg, ss3$pe)
  pe_figs <- list(
    list(
      plot = plot_pe_ts(ss3$pe),
      file = "ss3-ts.png",
      caption = "SS3 scenario time series relative to MSY reference points.",
      label = "fig:robustness-ss3-ts",
      width = 8,
      height = 8,
      fig_width = 0.92
    ),
    list(
      plot = plot_pe_residual_time(ss3$pe),
      file = "ss3-res-time.png",
      caption = "Process residuals by scenario (from curveSS).",
      label = "fig:robustness-ss3-res-time",
      width = 9,
      height = 4,
      fig_width = 0.92
    ),
    list(
      plot = plot_pe_residual_acf(ss3$pe),
      file = "ss3-res-acf.png",
      caption = "ACF of process residuals by scenario.",
      label = "fig:robustness-ss3-res-acf",
      width = 9,
      height = 3,
      fig_width = 0.92
    )
  )

  for (item in pe_figs) {
    fig_path <- save_appendix_figure(
      cfg,
      item$plot,
      strand = "robustness",
      filename = item$file,
      width = item$width,
      height = item$height
    )
    if (!is.null(fig_path) && file.exists(fig_path)) {
      output_lines <- c(
        output_lines,
        figure_fragment(
          cfg,
          fig_path,
          caption = item$caption,
          label = item$label,
          width = item$fig_width
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
  }
}

if (!is.null(st_rob) && !is.null(st_rob$retro)) {
  retro_figs <- list(
    list(
      plot = plot_retro_traj_msy(st_rob$retro),
      file = "retro-traj-msy.png",
      caption = "Retrospective peel trajectories vs MSY benchmarks (sstruth::retroBacktestData).",
      label = "fig:robustness-retro-traj",
      width = 10,
      height = 9,
      fig_width = 0.95
    ),
    list(
      plot = plot_retro_ratio_horizon(
        st_rob$retro,
        fore_col = "foreBratio",
        ref_col = "refBratio",
        ylab = "SSB / BMSY",
        title = "Multi-step SSB/BMSY ratios by peel",
        cfg = cfg
      ),
      file = "retro-bratio-horizon.png",
      caption = "Multi-horizon SSB/BMSY retrospective ratios (sstruth::plotRatios).",
      label = "fig:robustness-retro-bratio",
      width = 9,
      height = 8,
      fig_width = 0.92
    )
  )

  for (item in retro_figs) {
    fig_path <- save_appendix_figure(
      cfg,
      item$plot,
      strand = "robustness",
      filename = item$file,
      width = item$width,
      height = item$height
    )
    if (!is.null(fig_path) && file.exists(fig_path)) {
      output_lines <- c(
        output_lines,
        figure_fragment(
          cfg,
          fig_path,
          caption = item$caption,
          label = item$label,
          width = item$fig_width
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
  }
}

res_figs <- cfg$paper_figures
if (is.null(res_figs) || !length(res_figs)) {
  res_figs <- c("sma-fig-res-time-1.png", "sma-fig-res-acf-1.png")
} else {
  res_figs <- res_figs[grepl("res-", res_figs)]
}

for (fig in res_figs) {
  src <- file.path(cfg$project_dir, "figs", fig)
  if (file.exists(src)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        src,
        caption = gsub("-", " ", sub("\\.png$", "", fig)),
        label = paste0("fig:robustness-", sub("\\.png$", "", fig)),
        width = 0.92
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

write_content(cfg, "robustness/output.tex", output_lines)
```

```{r write-ensemble, include=FALSE}
ensemble_lines <- c(
  "% Best-assessment versus ensemble comparison (MVLN).",
  ""
)

if (!is.null(mvln) && !is.null(mvln$summary)) {
  mvln_tbl <- mvln_summary_table(mvln)
  if (!is.null(mvln_tbl)) {
    ensemble_lines <- c(
      ensemble_lines,
      paste0(
        "% Reference scenario: ", cfg$reference_scenario,
        "; MVLN Monte Carlo draws = ", mvln$mc, " per scenario."
      ),
      "",
      kable_fragment(
        mvln_tbl,
        caption = paste0(
          "MVLN terminal status and tail probabilities (year ",
          mvln$terminal_year,
          "). Compare estimation uncertainty (reference) with structural sensitivity scenarios."
        ),
        label = "tab:robustness-mvln-ensemble"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(weight_cmp) && NROW(weight_cmp)) {
    cmp_tbl <- ensemble_weight_comparison_table(weight_cmp)
    if (!is.null(cmp_tbl)) {
      ensemble_lines <- c(
        ensemble_lines,
        kable_fragment(
          cmp_tbl,
          caption = paste0(
            "Ensemble weight comparison by scenario: (i) equal weights; ",
            "(ii) ICES-style Akaike weights ",
            "$w_i \\propto \\exp(-\\Delta\\mathrm{AIC}/2)$ from total SS3 negative log-likelihood ",
            "(comparable models); (iii) CVindexmase; (iv) CVindexrho ",
            "(hindcast skill from retrospective peels; Scenarios 2--3 only until LOO CPUE is collected)."
          ),
          label = "tab:robustness-ensemble-weight-comparison"
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
  } else if (!is.null(cv_weights) && !is.null(cv_weights$weights) && NROW(cv_weights$weights)) {
    w_tbl <- cv_weights$weights
    num_cols <- vapply(w_tbl, is.numeric, logical(1))
    w_tbl[num_cols] <- lapply(w_tbl[num_cols], function(x) signif(x, 4))
    ensemble_lines <- c(
      ensemble_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        w_tbl,
        caption = paste0(
          "Scenario ensemble weights from hindcast CV (CVindexmase / CVindexrho; combine = ",
          cv_weights$combine_method %||% "average",
          "). Run run-ensemble-weights.R --collect for full comparison table."
        ),
        label = "tab:robustness-ensemble-cv-weights"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  mvln_figs <- list(
    list(
      plot = plot_mvln_kobe_ensemble(mvln),
      file = "mvln-kobe-terminal.png",
      caption = paste0(
        "Terminal-year Kobe-style comparison of MVLN draws: reference (",
        cfg$reference_scenario,
        ") vs structural sensitivity scenarios."
      ),
      label = "fig:robustness-mvln-kobe",
      width = 9,
      height = 7,
      fig_width = 0.92
    ),
    list(
      plot = plot_mvln_terminal_compare(mvln),
      file = "mvln-terminal-compare.png",
      caption = "Terminal MVLN medians and 5--95% intervals for SSB/BMSY and F/FMSY by scenario.",
      label = "fig:robustness-mvln-terminal",
      width = 9,
      height = 6,
      fig_width = 0.92
    ),
    list(
      plot = plot_mvln_status_ts(mvln),
      file = "mvln-status-ts.png",
      caption = "Recent-year MVLN status trajectories with 5--95% intervals by scenario.",
      label = "fig:robustness-mvln-ts",
      width = 9,
      height = 8,
      fig_width = 0.92
    )
  )

  for (item in mvln_figs) {
    fig_path <- save_appendix_figure(
      cfg,
      item$plot,
      strand = "robustness",
      filename = item$file,
      width = item$width,
      height = item$height
    )
    if (!is.null(fig_path) && file.exists(fig_path)) {
      ensemble_lines <- c(
        ensemble_lines,
        figure_fragment(
          cfg,
          fig_path,
          caption = item$caption,
          label = item$label,
          width = item$fig_width
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  ensemble_lines <- c(
    ensemble_lines,
    if (do_run) {
      c(
        "% MVLN ensemble not available; ensure mvtnorm is installed and SS3 runs include a covariance matrix.",
        paste0("% Expected scenarios under ", cfg$ss_base, "."),
        ""
      )
    } else {
      c(
        "% Set run_code = TRUE to populate MVLN best-assessment vs scenario comparison.",
        ""
      )
    }
  )
}

write_content(cfg, "robustness/ensemble.tex", ensemble_lines)
```
